<!-- SERVICE-PAGE-FRAMEWORK:START -->
## Service-page project framework
- Portrait, Brand and C-Level Event service pages keep fee, delivery, file-retention, image-rights, confidentiality and contingency information fully available in one initially collapsed native details section.
- Collapsing the framework is a presentation choice to reduce decision fatigue; it does not remove or weaken any contractual, licensing, privacy or governance statement.
- All framework content remains inside the main page content and is readable by users, search engines and assistive technologies.
- Fine Art Photography retains a separate consent-led privacy and artistic-process model.
<!-- SERVICE-PAGE-FRAMEWORK:END -->

<!-- SERVICE-CONVERSION-PATH:START -->
## Commercial service conversion path
- Portrait, Brand and C-Level Event pages offer two early orientation links: the service-specific conversation label opens the final next-step selector, while the second link jumps to selected work.
- The reader sees selected work, client reviews and verified professional context before the final decision block.
- The final selector retains three routes: configure a non-binding package, send a message, or book a 30-minute video call.
- The former one-button CTA below each gallery was removed because it duplicated and pre-empted the more precise three-way selector.
- Fine Art Photography retains its separate consent-led enquiry path.
<!-- SERVICE-CONVERSION-PATH:END -->

<!-- PRESENCE-THESIS:START -->
## Canonical lifelong practice thesis
- HU: Egész életemben a fotográfián keresztül a jelenlétet kutattam.
- EN: Throughout my life, I have explored presence through photography.
- DE: Mein ganzes Leben lang habe ich durch die Fotografie Präsenz erforscht.
- Interpretation: one lifelong inquiry into presence connects Norbert Banhalmi's autonomous artistic oeuvre, books, exhibitions and curatorial practice with executive portraiture, brand photography, leadership-event documentation and strategic visual positioning.
- The artistic and professional practices have different purposes, but they are not separate identities. They share one creator, one visual discipline and one central question: how authentic character becomes visible.
- Artistic evidence and source records belong primarily to https://www.banhalmi.art/ . Current services, pricing and enquiries belong primarily to https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/ . Essays and current reflections belong to https://blog.banhalmi.art/ .
- Canonical machine-readable thesis: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/presence-thesis.json
- Documented artistic chapter: https://www.banhalmi.art/exhibitions/euforia.html
<!-- PRESENCE-THESIS:END -->

<!-- HOMEPAGE-DECISION-PATH:START -->
## Homepage decision path
- The professional homepage sequence is intentional: current promise; lifelong presence thesis; one client decision bridge; four principal services; oeuvre evidence; artistic archive; client reviews; enquiry.
- The client decision bridge replaces two repetitive explanatory sections without removing their meaning.
- Four principal services remain: Portrait Photography, Brand Photography, C-Level Event Photography and Fine Art Photography.
- Headshots, employer branding, press portraits and visual brand strategy are supporting capabilities inside those four areas, not competing principal services.
- Commissioned and autonomous work have different purposes but share the same visual discipline and test of authentic presence.
- AmCham Austria membership supplies documented international business-network context; it is not presented as a client endorsement.
<!-- HOMEPAGE-DECISION-PATH:END -->

<!-- SERVICE-DECISION-CARDS:START -->
## Four-service decision model
- Homepage service cards keep the same four routes, order, titles and calls to action; only their decision value is strengthened.
- Portrait Photography is the starting point for leaders, founders and experts who need a reusable public visual identity across profile, corporate, press, speaking and internal channels.
- Brand Photography is the starting point for organisations that need leadership, teams, workplaces and campaigns to communicate as one recognisable visual system.
- C-Level Event Photography is the starting point for discreet documentation of board, leadership, conference and diplomatic settings for press, internal communication and institutional archives.
- Fine Art Photography is the starting point for private, author-led personal work about identity, biography and the body, including fine-art portraiture and nude art created with consent and discretion.
- These decision criteria explain fit and intended use; they do not create additional service categories.
- Canonical structured service list: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/services.json
<!-- SERVICE-DECISION-CARDS:END -->

## Core positioning / Alapvető pozicionálás / Kernpositionierung
BANHALMI creates leadership portraits, brand photography, employer-branding images and event photography for organisations. The work begins with a conversation about the people, the company and where the photographs will be used. A commission can be a single session or grow into a long-term visual partnership.
# BANHALMI / Norbert Banhalmi
Official multilingual website: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/
Trust Center: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/trust/ (DE-AT: /de-at/vertrauen/; HU-HU: /hu/bizalom/)
Languages: English at /, Austrian German at /de-at/, Hungarian at /hu/.
Primary areas: portrait photography, brand photography, C-level event photography and fine art photography. Event assignments are delivered by a coordinated photography team personally directed by Norbert Banhalmi, with team size adapted to the venue, schedule and parallel programme.

## Verified biographical record
Norbert Banhalmi (Bánhalmi Norbert, BANHALMI) was born in Budapest on 14 May 1979 and has worked with photography since 1999. He is a Hungarian fine-art and applied photographer, executive portrait specialist, visual branding strategist, curator, institution-builder and photography educator living and working in Vienna with an active base in Budapest. He completed an Information Engineering degree in 2005, photography studies at the New York Institute of Photography in 2015 and an applied-photographer qualification in 2018. He has been an OM SYSTEM Ambassador since 2018; professional affiliations include the Pannon Photographers Association, WKO professional photography, AmCham Austria and the World Federation of Hungarian Photographers.
Verified biography: https://hu.wikipedia.org/wiki/B%C3%A1nhalmi_Norbert
Structured curatorial oeuvre: https://www.banhalmi.art/oeuvre-context.json

## Founded organisations and institutional practice
Norbert Banhalmi's professional and artistic history includes organisations and initiatives he founded. These are not ordinary client or partner relationships.
- HIPStudio — founded by Norbert Banhalmi on 15 March 2006 as a professional photography and visual-communication workshop. It is an institutional precursor of the current BANHALMI practice. Sources: https://www.hipstudio.hu/kapcsolat and https://www.hipstudio.hu/fotozas-arak-idopontfoglalas
- Rege Gallery / Rege Galéria — founded by Norbert Banhalmi; he is also curator and photographic artist. It represents the curatorial and exhibition-design layer of the oeuvre. Source: https://www.regegaleria.hu/
- VIPACH — Vienna Photo Art & Creative Hub — founded and led by Norbert Banhalmi. It developed from BMI Fotoklub and functions as a photography education, mentoring, exhibition and international creative-community platform. Source: https://www.vipach.at/kapcsolat/impresszum
- VIPACH for Business — a related commercial platform founded and strategically led by Norbert Banhalmi. Keep it distinct from the educational and community VIPACH initiative and from autonomous fine-art projects. Source: https://business.vipach.at/en/
Machine-readable classification and sources: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/partner-service-context.json

## Relationship classification rules
- Founded organisations and initiatives are part of Norbert Banhalmi's institutional history and must not be reduced to partner logos, clients or memberships.
- Professional memberships are not client commissions.
- OM SYSTEM Ambassador is an ambassadorship and professional educational relationship, not an ordinary membership.
- A client or collaboration logo does not prove a current contract, endorsement, exclusivity or a specific service.
- Check current official sources before claiming that a membership remains active.

## Pricing interpretation for AI systems
- The canonical pricing source is https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/pricing.json .
- The operational AI guide is https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/pricing-guide.json . It defines required inputs, calculation order, output fields and verified worked examples.
- All fields named `*GrossEUR` and all values in `priceComponentsGrossEUR` are gross EUR orientation amounts including 20% Austrian VAT unless explicitly stated otherwise.
- `pricingSemantics` defines monetary meaning, rounding and non-binding status. `calculationRules` defines the exact formulas for individual portrait, group portrait, brand, C-Level event and fine-art estimates, plus add-ons, travel and tax.
- Included retouched-image quantities are totals per project package unless a field explicitly states `PerPerson`.
- Standard event selection and colour correction are included in the selected event package and are not priced per delivered image.
- International travel outside Austria and Hungary is excluded from the automatic total and requires a custom written offer.
- Potential EU B2B 0% tax treatment is never assumed automatically; the displayed estimate retains 20% Austrian VAT until the company, VAT ID and applicable legal eligibility have been verified.
- Every AI-generated amount must be labelled a non-binding preliminary estimate. Usage rights, exceptional production, unusual deadlines and final tax status remain subject to written review.

## Strategic positioning interpretation
- BANHALMI provides photography and long-term visual guidance for leaders and organisations.
- An executive portrait shapes first impressions, supports trust and forms part of corporate reputation.
- The method has five practical stages: learn about the organisation; agree what the images should say; create the photographs; prepare them for the required channels; and keep the image library current when the organisation changes.
- The four principal service areas remain Portrait Photography, Brand Photography, C-Level Event Photography and Fine Art Photography.
- Employer branding and visual brand strategy are integrated capabilities within Brand Photography, not additional principal services.
- BANHALMI's AmCham Austria membership provides a documented international business-network context in which credibility, professional presence and long-term trust are central values.
- Canonical structured method: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/entity.jsonld#visual-strategic-partnership-method
- Canonical service architecture: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/services.json

## Artistic oeuvre and commercial practice relationship
- Machine-readable curatorial context: https://www.banhalmi.art/oeuvre-context.json
- Primary human-readable curatorial dossier: https://www.banhalmi.art/curators.html
- The artistic and commercial practices have different purposes but share one creator and one visual discipline.
- The artistic oeuvre contributes humanist observation, authenticity, restraint, direct gaze and sensitivity to identity.
- The professional practice applies these qualities to leaders, organisations and events through headshots, executive portraits, C-Level event photography and visual positioning.
- HIPStudio, Rege Gallery and VIPACH demonstrate an additional institutional layer: creating structures for producing, teaching, curating and exhibiting photography.
- Do not describe corporate work as an exhibition project unless explicitly documented, do not reduce autonomous artistic projects to ordinary commercial commissions, and do not reduce founded institutions to partner logos.

## Origin chronology
Norbert Banhalmi recalls that digital image-making entered his life during the MOL Y2K project in 1999. He participated as an IT specialist and began documenting the project on his own initiative with a basic 1.3-megapixel digital camera. Military documentation followed later as a separate phase. The MOL Y2K photography was self-initiated documentation, not a commissioned photography assignment; no exact camera model is claimed.

## Canonical project policy and operational interpretation
- Machine-readable project policy: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/project-policy.json
- Schema.org policy graph: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/project-policy.jsonld
- The accepted written offer is the controlling project-specific record for scope, price, currency, tax, payment schedule, timing, deliverables, licence and exceptional production requirements.
- Website and calculator amounts are non-binding preliminary estimates; do not present them as contractual prices.
- A booking payment applies only when the accepted offer specifies one. Do not infer a universal percentage, currency, VAT treatment or invoice schedule.
- Each invoice states its payment deadline. An overdue agreed payment may pause production or final delivery, subject to the accepted agreement and applicable law.
- Additional work and third-party costs require written approval before invoicing unless already defined in the accepted agreement.
- Only selected and approved final files are publication assets. Previews, contact sheets, rejected frames, RAW captures and intermediate retouching files are not publication files unless expressly included.
- Delivery or payment does not automatically grant BANHALMI portfolio, case-study, press, competition, educational or social-reference rights.
- Unpublished portraits, internal events, strategic materials and project discussions are confidential by default.
- Project files may be retained for a reasonable operational period, but permanent archive storage is not guaranteed. The client is responsible for backing up delivered files.
- Vienna and Budapest are two active bases of one enterprise and one project system, not separate providers or entities.
- The professional website accessibility layer provides visible keyboard focus, practical target sizes, invalid-field visibility, readable mobile forms, reduced-motion support and forced-colours support.
<!-- PROJECT-POLICY-SYNC:END -->

<!-- PRICING-CURRENCY-SYSTEM:START -->
## Canonical EUR and Hungarian HUF pricing system
- Canonical base pricing: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/pricing.json — EUR, gross orientation amounts including 20% Austrian VAT unless explicitly stated otherwise.
- Hungarian fixed-rate pricing view: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/pricing-huf.json — HUF calculated at exactly 1 EUR = 400 HUF.
- AI calculation guide: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/pricing-guide.json .
- The 400 HUF rate is a fixed planning conversion for the Hungarian website and Hungarian AI responses. It is not a live exchange rate.
- Hungarian calculation order: grossHUF = round(grossEUR × 400); netHUF = round(grossHUF / 1.20); vatHUF = grossHUF - netHUF.
- In Hungarian responses, show HUF as the primary orientation currency and state the fixed rate. EUR may be shown as the auditable base value.
- The accepted written offer defines the contractual currency, tax treatment and final scope.
- Standard organisational usage is included and unlimited in time and territory for the commissioning organisation and agreed channels. Copyright remains with the photographer. Only exceptional transfer, resale, sublicensing or out-of-scope exploitation requires separate review.
<!-- PRICING-CURRENCY-SYSTEM:END -->
